readmeHtml:
Corsair: Connect your users to their apps

Website · Discord · X

Corsair is a fully-featured product integration platform with a seamless DX. Build anything, from an agent working across all your integrations to a multi-tenant dashboard for your users to connect to anything.

Why does this exist?

More than MCP

Most agent integration tools are MCP-only. Corsair is built on a REST API, so the same integration layer works for agents, backend services, and the dashboards your customers use.

One syntax for every integration

The more third-party APIs your agent touches, the more glue code you write. Corsair gives every integration the same syntax, and we maintain the adapters behind it. Connect once instead of rewriting plumbing for each new tool.

Open source, your data

Closed integration platforms keep your users' tokens and data on infrastructure you can't inspect or leave. Corsair is open source. Self-host it, or use Hub if you want us to handle OAuth refresh and webhooks. Your data remains yours either way.

Contributing

We welcome PRs for the core library, docs, tooling, and new integration plugins. Read CONTRIBUTING.md for the full workflow.

For a new integration, claim it on the OSS Integrations page before you start, then open an issue with the API you want to add. Questions? Ask in Discord.

License

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. See LICENSE for details.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An open-source product integration platform providing a unified REST API for third-party connections.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Corsair is a self-hostable integration platform that simplifies connecting your application to third-party APIs. By offering a unified syntax through a REST API, it eliminates the need to write custom plumbing and OAuth logic for every new tool you support. It is designed to power both autonomous agents working across integrations and user-facing dashboards. Since it is open-source, developers can self-host the infrastructure to ensure sensitive tokens and user data remain on their own servers, avoiding closed ecosystem lock-in.
keyFeatures: Unified syntax: Interact with multiple third-party APIs using a single, standardized interface.
REST API foundation: Works for traditional backend services, dashboards, and AI agents alike.
Self-hostable: Deploy on your own infrastructure to maintain total ownership of user data.
OAuth management: Handles token refresh and authentication flows automatically.
Multi-tenant support: Built to power user-facing dashboards where customers connect their own apps.
Managed Hub option: Offers a hosted version for developers who want to offload infrastructure.
